Welcome to Day Two! Today is the mathiest. We will learn about the Yule model, the birth-death model, and variations that include incopmlete sampling/obesrvation of lineages. Buckle up. 


By the end of today, you will be able to derive Kolmogorov equations forwards and backwards. You will even get to solve some PDEs!
